findings.one_line: The step from unrestricted generic fibre rows in (14) to (17) fixes one row in each fibre to w_c without proof: algebraic independence over Q does not preserve a nonempty Zariski-open condition defined over F_S after specialization w_c∈F_S; hence the constrained Rado attainment, and thus (17)--(21), is not reproduced.
